elements_selected.content: Implement chain walking in src/web/chain.rs to compute chain_position, chain_length, and chain_head_slug. Add compute_chain_position that walks backward via prev pointers to find chain head, then forward to count total length. Returns position/length/head_slug tuple or None if not in a chain. Detect cycles by tracking visited pages. Cap at 1000 steps. Also add find_chain_heads to detect all pages with next but no prev. Update build_page_context to call compute_chain_position and populate the chain fields. REQ-015-005, REQ-015-007.
